verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit exposes first-party dispute tools: list_disputes and get_dispute for status, and accept_dispute_claim for one outcome path. The REST API overview lists a disputes API on the same rails, so dispute handling via API is documented for PayPal-processed agent orders. However, nothing in the evidence shows evidence submission or contesting a dispute. Chargebacks on Braintree-processed ACP/UCP agent transactions are not addressed, and no dispute-specific webhook events or outcome tracking are shown. Missing for 10: documented evidence-submission/contest endpoints, chargeback handling for Braintree Agent Ready (ACP/UCP) transactions, dispute outcome/resolution lifecycle and dispute webhook events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
